text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Ikuno. It's not much,
but I have a
present for you as well.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Oh? You didn't have to, but thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Aw, I didn't know you guys were so
close.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
When you put it so plainly, I do feel a
bit bashful,
but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
From having the proper mindset before a
race to
the importance of thinking
ahead, I've learned
much from Ikuno's
example.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So I guess you're kinda like a mentor to
McQueen
then, huh, Ikuno?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I find it difficult to believe myself, but if
my
advice has been of use to you, then
I'm glad.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Did you find the list of places with
low-calorie
sweets I gave you the other
day helpful?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
About that... it's embarrassing to admit,
but I've
already been to all of them. I
cannot thank you
enough...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Guess you look to Ikuno's
advice for a
lot more than just racing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A-anyhow, I'm grateful for all you do,
and hope
you'll allow me to gleam more
knowledge from
you in the future.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Of course, you can expect more tips on
new
sweets to try.
